description:
Step two of two. Spends the confirmation_token from publish_pages and makes each page in the summary in App Store Connect, one job for each page. Returns the jobs: call get_job for each.
Call it only after the person has seen the summary and the preview links from publish_pages and has said yes, in their own words, to publishing those pages. If they asked for a change, make it and call publish_pages again. This is hard to undo: a page can be taken back in the web app only until it is submitted for review.
Nothing is submitted for review: the developer submits each page to Apple in App Store Connect. The default product page, the keyword field, the app binary, pricing and in-app purchases are not changed. A page that changed after the summary refuses the whole confirmation and nothing is sent.

confirmation_token.description: The confirmation_token publish_pages returned, starting pfc_.

name: confirm_publish
title: Confirm and publish
